added_failures_note: unmeasured: the reviewed manifest's baseline_suite and after_suite fields are both null, so the reviewed run names no base gate log and no head gate log and the added-failure count was not taken

findings.text: SESSION_HOST_STATE_DIRECTORY = "session-hosts" (reckon/crew/dispatch.py:1337) and _session_host_record_path (reckon/crew/dispatch.py:1365) re-derive the directory the host writes its census to instead of resolving it through session_host._state_dir (reckon/crew/session_host.py:86-95), which owns that path and honours RECKON_SESSION_HOST_STATE_DIR (reckon/crew/session_host.py:59). Only RECORD_SUFFIX is imported (reckon/crew/dispatch.py:1363), so the suffix agrees while the directory does not: with the override set for the host process and not for the dispatch process, dispatch reads an empty directory and reports monitor for a host-delivered session — the very mis-report this node removes. _session_host_record_path also re-computes the CLAUDE_PID and start-tick stem that _session_host_fifo (reckon/crew/dispatch.py:1317-1330) already builds, so the two sibling resolvers can drift.

_write_host_record (tests/test_dispatch_session_host.py:153-162) hardcodes config_home/"crew"/"session-hosts" and the ".json" suffix rather than resolving them through the host module (reckon/crew/session_host.py _state_dir, RECORD_SUFFIX), so the fixture can drift from the writer the code under test reads in step: if the host's directory name or suffix changes, the fixture and _session_host_record_path are edited in different places and this test keeps passing against a directory the host never writes.

item_verdicts.write_paths: the manifest declares reckon/crew/dispatch.py, tests/test_dispatch_session_host.py and the evidence fragment; git diff --stat 37b548ccf..636673866 names exactly those three files and nothing else.

justifications.durability: the declared negative control (_session_host_runs_follower returning False) reddens test_dispatch_reads_host_for_an_already_attached_host_follower with 1 failed, EXIT=1, a real guard, and the foreign-pid case (tests/test_dispatch_session_host.py:331+) fails if the match ignores the pid; but the fixture writes the host record into a directory and suffix it hardcodes rather than the host's, so the test can pass while the reader and the writer drift.
justifications.evidence: gate-host-delivery.log records 14 passed EXIT=0 for tests/test_dispatch_session_host.py and tests/test_session_host.py, which is the done-when's measure; the gate log's first line names the base revision 37b548ccf rather than the landed 636673866, so the figure is not tied to the landed commit by its own header.
justifications.fit: the added names SESSION_HOST_STATE_DIRECTORY, _session_host_record_path and _session_host_runs_follower are mechanism names with no plan, ticket or version id and no attribution; the comment at reckon/crew/dispatch.py:1359 overstates that the name dispatch reads is the host's own, since only the suffix is imported.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/dispatch.py:7411 reads the calling session's host census and sets delivery "host" for a session already attached by that host's own follower, exactly the node goal; the foreign-follower case (tests/test_dispatch_session_host.py:331) still reads monitor.
justifications.reuse: _session_host_record_path (reckon/crew/dispatch.py:1340) re-derives the census directory the host owns via session_host._state_dir (reckon/crew/session_host.py:86), importing only RECORD_SUFFIX, and re-computes the CLAUDE_PID/start-tick stem that _session_host_fifo (reckon/crew/dispatch.py:1317) already builds, extending neither owner.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff --stat reckon/crew/dispatch.py lists only the three files the manifest declares, all inside the fenced write paths; no figure was written though the scope allowed one, matching the done-when naming no artifact.
